claims.statement: Trigger.dev disclosed on November 1, 2026 that an attacker gained unauthorized access to environment variables for a subset of organizations, and said it had blocked the exploit used.
Trigger.dev emailed affected account owners with mitigation steps; it has not said how many organizations were affected, how the attacker got in, or which variables were read.
When The Register asked for more detail, Trigger.dev pointed to a forthcoming full incident report.
